DML.SELECT: SELECT stretch_id as "stretchId", location_id as "locationId", position as "position", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.stretch_locations WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.stretch_locations (stretch_id, location_id, position, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:stretchId, :locationId, :position, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.stretch_locations WHERE stretch_id = :stretchId AND location_id = :locationId
